name: Wong

skills.orange: Kamar-Taj Technique : Each time you attack with Martial Arts, you may spend 1 * to have your Attack roll only a single die (no bonuses possible) but gain +2 to the die result. If successful, it deals 3 Hits.

boss_enemy.ability: Last in Target Priority. When he spawns, roll a die and place it on this card, representing a Mystic Shield. Each time a Hit is allocated to his Zone, reduce the Shield by 1. Enemies in his Zone cannot be allocated Hits until the Shield is eliminated.
